purpose: Maximize the number of accepted recent same-track comparators while preserving Wave1 evidence first and preventing heavy I/O, model services, and numerical jobs from perturbing one another.
global_release_gate: the Wave1 recovery controller is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED without TERMINAL_REJECTED
all Wave1 answer, embedding, evaluator, and controller processes have exited
no process references a fresh target of the next stage
fresh-root, storage-headroom, and source-identity checks pass

phases.reason: Raw comparison evidence must be accepted and archived before any new high-I/O acquisition.
phases.exit_gate: All four stages are independently TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and both archive inventories validate.

phases.reason: The frozen lifecycle covers eight methods and therefore has the highest comparator yield per setup transition.
phases.exit_gate: Every eligible lifecycle root is audited; only then freeze its three-seed numerical successor.

phases.reason: MemoryOS and MemGAS add two recent official-code comparators with moderate model footprint.
phases.exit_gate: Both lifecycle roots are audited; only then freeze their three-seed numerical successors.

phases.reason: Hindsight is a recent official-code comparator but requires a larger isolated dependency surface and embedded service.
phases.exit_gate: The embedded-service lifecycle is audited; only then freeze its three-seed numerical successor.

phases.reason: StructMem is retained as an ACL 2026 comparator with exact source and model identity, but its dependency chain still requires post-lock successor freezes.
phases.exit_gate: Freeze and accept lock export, wheelhouse, isolated environment, lifecycle, and then the three-seed numerical successor.

numeric_admission.agentenhance_gate: AgentEnhance remains locked until all runnable required public baselines have accepted local summaries or an immutable external blocker is audited.

failure_semantics: A rejected stage is preserved and audited. Only a new frozen recovery may change a technical mechanism; method, seed, sample, metric, and slice selection never change after values are observed.
cleanup: No stage in this sequence authorizes deletion. Only project-owned run-specific model targets may later enter the separate ownership, dependency, archive, quarantine, and deletion policy; shared or pre-existing models never do.
prohibited: starting any post-Wave1 stage before global release
running a heavy archive, model acquisition, wheelhouse, or numerical job concurrently
skipping an unfavorable accepted method, seed, sample, metric, or slice
starting AgentEnhance early to choose favorable baseline coverage
claiming overall SOTA from a lifecycle, archive, partial comparison, or favorable slice alone
